text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I come out of the race as the grand<n>victor! Taiki may
beat me when it<n>comes to toughness, but I win out
when it comes to speed! However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That was a 1,200-meter race on<n>Japan's short turf
over a firm track...<n>All the conditions were tilted in
my<n>favor. I can't very well say I<n>surpassed the
world champion in light<n>of that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run against Taiki in the<n>Mile
Championship! My chances of<n>winning are
extremely close to zero!
